name: NSW apprentice travel and accommodation allowance (VTAS)
summary: NSW pays apprentices and new entrant trainees per kilometre and per night when they travel far for day or block release training.
key: From 1 November 2025, $0.52 per km travel and $70 per night accommodation.
who: Registered in NSW as an apprentice or new entrant trainee with a NSW workplace
Travel more than 110 km return for day or block release training
how: Complete the VTAS form, sign it, have your RTO sign and endorse it, and lodge it with your local Training Services NSW office.
catches: Claims must be submitted by 30 June following the year of travel.
Claims submitted after 1 November 2025 are not backdated to the new rates.

source.label: NSW Department of Education: Travel, accommodation and relocation assistance package

evidence.quote: VTAS claims must be submitted by 30 June following the year of travel.
